$comment: Altitude presets (owner, 2026-09-30): Jeddah at sea level, Riyadh at about 600 m (the default, with the 45 °C default ambient) and a custom elevation. Pressure at an elevation comes from the International Standard Atmosphere below. Research: docs/research/part2b/altitude-and-fuels.json.

sources.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA / NASA / USAF, NASA-TM-X-74335)
sources.note: The reference-level value for P_b for b = 0 is the defined sea-level value, P_0 = 101325.0 N/m² (1013.250 mb).

sources.title: NOAA National Weather Service (El Paso), weather calculator notes: "Pressure Altitude"
U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA / NASA / USAF, NASA-TM-X-74335)
sources.note: The standard sea-level temperature T0 is 288.15 K. This value is based upon two international agreements.

sources.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA / NASA / USAF, NASA-TM-X-74335)
sources.note: TABLE 4 ... Subscript b 0 | Geopotential height H_b (km') 0 | Molecular-scale temperature gradient L_M,b (K/km') −6.5

sources.title: U.S. Standard Atmosphere, 1976 (NOAA / NASA / USAF, NASA-TM-X-74335)
sources.note: TABLE 2.—Adopted constants ... R* 8.31432 × 10³ N·m/(kmol·K) ... g0' 9.80665 m²/(s²·m') ... M0 28.9644 kg/kmol

exponent.note: g0' M0 / (R* L) = 9.80665 × 28.9644 / (8314.32 × 0.0065) = 5.25588, from the Standard's own constants (arithmetic, not printed). The NWS formula's 0.190284 is its inverse to four figures.

formula.value: p = p0 × (1 − L h / T0)^(g0' M0 / (R* L)), h in geopotential metres, below 11 km

elevation.method: Rounded to sea level as the owner set the preset (101.3 kPa). The city stands 7-12 m above the sea; 12 m would take 0.14 kPa off the pressure.

sources.title: WMO Climate Normals 1991-2020, Jeddah KAIA (WMO 41024, 17 m), NOAA NCEI accession 0253808

locations.notes: July mean at the airport barometer (17 m): the hot season's low pressure sits about 1 kPa under the standard atmosphere.

sources.note: The city of Riyadh is located approximately 1,950 feet (600 meters) above sea level

elevation.note: The city spreads over a sloping plateau (600-635 m across sources); the in-city weather station is at 620 m and King Khalid airport at 625.8 m.

sources.title: WMO Climate Normals 1991-2020, Riyadh New (King Khalid airport, WMO 40437, barometer 614 m), NOAA NCEI accession 0253808

locations.notes: The standard atmosphere gives 94.2 kPa at 612 m, the owner's 'about 94 kPa'. On a July afternoon the barometer averages 93.4 kPa: hot air is lighter, which costs about 1 % more power than the preset shows.
